method: 250 composite A/B tiles, one per location, drawn seeded (seed 20260911) over the smooth-routed candidate-ledger rows reading p_fine(>=4) >= solve.DEFAULT_FINE_BAR = 0.030242 under the shipped fine head twelve_sheets_drop_high_asymmetric_auc_ge4_more_k3, at cycles 1 and phase 0, at the candidate regime, with a picture on disk and NO human verdict in either finished store. 2,549 such rows at 2,082 places; the draw shuffles places at the seed, takes 250, and picks one qualifying row at each seeded-uniform rather than the best-scoring. Each tile is one picture: the 1x render on the LEFT and the same recipe at cycles 2 on the RIGHT, both at 1280x720 ss2 through the baseline's own levelled colormap, equal halves, a 6px separator, nothing written on the image. Folded 61 / cyclic 189, so 61 tiles ask about a 4x traversal and 189 about a 2x one. The page is a seeded shuffle and every unit is prefilled at 2 (neutral). curate repeat-ab plan --name repeat_ab_ckpt121 --seed 20260911 --units 250.
why: score_unconditioned is FALSE and that is the leg rather than a defect: the population is CONDITIONAL on the fine bar, because the only repetition Matt will consider is an improvement on a picture already good at 1x. Any rate measured here is a rate about pictures above the bar and is a CEILING on a rate about the pool. anchored is FALSE: no head's decode prefilled anything and no score ordered the page. The prefill is the constant 2 stated by the plan, and the order is a seeded shuffle -- both deliberate deviations from this rig's correction-sheet default, because the premise of the sitting is that the heads cannot read this axis and a score order or a head prefill would import that error into page position and into the anchor. The scale is COMPARATIVE and three-point -- 1 the repeat is worse, 2 neutral, 3 the repeat is better -- and is NOT the 1..4 quality scale: these verdicts may never enter smooth_render, strange_render or gallery_grade, as themselves or transformed. phase is held at 0 on both halves so this is not confounded with the rotation axis. ONE unit per location. See data/batch_caveats.md.
